title: Implement and publish the DappGo News RSS reader
question: Can the existing published US/TW RSS-derived report data power a lightweight Cloudflare Pages news reader without changing the production pipeline?
hypotheses: The existing latest pointer and immutable dashboard payload provide enough stable news fields for a reader-only site.
A static Pages deployment can serve /tw and /us while the browser polls the existing gateway pointer without a new backend.
acceptance_criteria: Reader routes /tw and /us load from Cloudflare Pages and use the existing data gateway latest pointer plus immutable payload.
Stock navigation, newest-first news cards, source links, dates and available thumbnails work for both markets; missing media becomes a natural text-only card.
The reader never triggers a pipeline, provider call, publication, or mutation; polling is bounded and an update banner preserves the reading position.
Local contract, browser, accessibility, and production route checks pass; exact Pages deployment identity and live routes are recorded.
evidence: Owner explicitly requested formal RSS integration, Cloudflare Pages deployment, and /tw and /us public routes.
Existing gateway pointers and immutable payloads were read successfully before implementation.
